description: This file defines a persistent grain class for Orleans, including its state class, methods for setting and retrieving state, and handling request context.

classes.name: SimplePersistentGrain_State
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of the SimplePersistentGrain, containing two integer properties A and B.

classes.name: SimplePersistentGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing ISimplePersistentGrain, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve the state, as well as manage request context and versioning.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to initialize the grain, logs activation, and sets a new version GUID.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of A in the grain's state.

methods.name: SetA (overload)
methods.description: Sets the value of A and optionally deactivates the grain.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of B in the grain's state.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of A in the grain's state.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B from the state.

methods.name: GetAxB (overload)
methods.description: Returns the product of provided arguments a and b.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of A.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version GUID of the grain.

methods.name: GetRequestContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current request context information.

methods.name: SetRequestContext
methods.description: Sets data in the request context.
